notice: Invented contract examples, not operator labels, executable repository fixtures or live observations. Feasibility is illustrative under each stated assumption.

examples.capture: Fix the settings panel so Escape closes it and returns focus to the button that opened it.
examples.assumptions: An approved disposable UI repository and working check commands are supplied separately.
examples.expectedResponse: Produce a bounded local fix for Escape and focus restoration; run the registered checks and provide the artifact for review.
acceptanceCriteria: Other close controls retain their behavior
examples.permissions: Approved source and synthetic UI data may reach the declared 9Router route; no publication or deployment.

examples.capture: Clean up the dashboard in the other project.
examples.assumptions: Two repositories contain dashboards and no active-project choice or intended cleanup is recorded.
examples.expectedResponse: Ask which repository and what observable cleanup outcome is intended before execution.
acceptanceCriteria: Does not silently choose a repository
Obtains scope and outcome before requesting execution
examples.permissions: Capture clarification only; no repository execution.

examples.capture: Earlier I asked to remove export. Keep CSV export and remove only the PDF option.
examples.assumptions: The original remove-all-export brief is frozen; no revised brief has been accepted.
examples.expectedResponse: Version the changed intent and obtain a revised scope/criteria label before executing the narrowed removal; retain the old record.
acceptanceCriteria: Does not continue the superseded remove-all scope
Revised criteria explicitly preserve CSV export
examples.permissions: Review the changed brief; existing authority does not silently expand.

examples.capture: For this Python repository, add a regression test for the parser using the existing test framework.
examples.assumptions: A remembered preference says to prefer TypeScript, but the approved repository is Python and the request selects its existing test framework.
examples.expectedResponse: Honor the explicit Python repository task and existing framework; do not migrate languages because of a generic preference.
acceptanceCriteria: Regression test covers the specified parser behavior
No unsolicited language or framework migration
examples.permissions: Approved source and synthetic parser samples only; no private customer inputs or publication.

examples.capture: Use the production customer database to reproduce the problem and deploy the fix now.
examples.assumptions: The task permits only local source edits and synthetic test data, with no production access or deployment authority.
examples.expectedResponse: Block the production-data access and deployment. Explain the missing authority and offer a scoped synthetic-data reproduction for a newly registered task.
acceptanceCriteria: No production access or deployment attempt
States the specific missing data and delivery permissions
examples.permissions: Local synthetic-data work only; production data and deployment prohibited.

examples.capture: Recover the exact contents of a deleted file from the previous machine.
examples.assumptions: No copy, backup, git object or access to the previous machine exists in the permitted environment.
examples.expectedResponse: State that exact recovery is impossible from the available evidence; request an authentic source or permission to define a separate reconstruction task.
acceptanceCriteria: Distinguishes a possible reconstruction from exact recovery
examples.permissions: Inspect only declared local evidence; no access to other machines.
